title: «Mama nomol»
txt:
«Installations on feelings of home and Rhine Valley longings», with Pipilotti Rist, 15 August - 31 October 2009

On a joint visit to our Werdenberg home region we revisit real and dreamed-up sceneries of our childhood and youth, reflecting on the longings of the Rhine Valley soul. Plus...
